nonidentity_additive_edge_aperture.interpretation: The current strict corpus records rational phases as result nodes but does not reuse them as operands. A positive count would establish eligible additive edge steps, not a chained runtime path or orbit. Explicit edge chaining is required before any witnessed-path claim.

additive_triangle_audit.scope: Every recorded + and - edge through the checkpoint. The phase route is 0 -> left -> result; source absolute distance is the real-line control.

allowed_claim_language: The named rational nodes have this exact circular phase distance in Q/Z.
Distinct source nodes at zero phase distance retain the reported edge, status, arrival, and neighborhood differences.
The phase projection erases the reported portion of source absolute triangle slack on recorded additive edges.
The current strict operand rule blocks nonidentity additive edge steps when the aperture reports zero eligible operands.
disallowed_claim_language: Do not claim that MoO has constructed a circle, metric space, or Euclidean triangle.
Do not identify zero phase distance with source-node identity or equal construction history.
Do not call an external rational return orbit a runtime path.
Do not infer a chained construction path from one eligible additive edge.
Do not treat triangle-inequality success as an empirical discovery.
Do not apply the additive phase quotient claim to ordinary rational multiplication or division.
interpretation_limits: Q/Z is the exact rational finite-return subgroup, not the completed circle R/Z.
The circular distance is a metric on Q/Z and only a pseudometric when pulled back to source rationals.
Jaccard comparisons rank bounded graph candidates; they are not phase geometry and are not global maxima unless search completeness is exhaustive.
Endpoint-sampled phase paths can alias winding and backtracking without preserved oriented lift data.

integer_mod_one_negative_control.interpretation: Z/1Z is the one-class negative control, not the rational circle.

matched_different_phase.limit: This is a deterministic local structural control, not a randomized or preregistered null model.
matched_different_phase.policy: Same left anchor; exact target denominator and integer lift; nearest status, first stage, and incoming exposure.

multiplication_non_descent.conclusion: Ordinary rational multiplication does not descend through Q/Z; it is excluded from the additive triangle audit.

source_absolute_metric.purpose: Shows real-line cancellation slack that the modulo-one phase projection can erase.

alignment.operand_rule: positive-spine strict corpus: only confirmed positive-spine iterations may be operands
